title_template: {work_unit_id} — Durable autonomous continuation multi-session steady state
goal: Generalize the proven WU-115/WU-116 provider-truth-backed session resume path into a reusable multi-session steady-state contract where every independent ChatGPT/Codex session starts from fresh canonical provider truth, discards persisted authority, performs at most one delegated transaction per admitted iteration and leaves a durable clean or explicitly reconcilable handoff boundary.
scope: define a reusable multi-session continuation invariant covering session start, fresh provider reconciliation, WU-108/WU-109 recomputation, bounded delegated execution, readback and durable handoff checkpoint refresh
prove checkpoint identity may advance across sessions while prior checkpoints remain immutable history and never mutation authority
require every new session to select current canonical Work Unit from fresh provider truth rather than inherit a prior session target
define deterministic supersession of old clean checkpoints after main, Work Unit, lease, branch, PR, CI or provider-state advancement
preserve interrupted/readback-pending reconciliation as a first-class session-start path before any new mutation
define bounded retention and public-safe evidence semantics sufficient for future autonomous Human-by-Exception readiness assessment
forbidden_scope: create a persistent bearer token, implicit session authority or reusable mutation credential inside a checkpoint
reuse prior-session control-loop, execution-admission, registry CAS, CI-success or merge-eligibility decisions
allow more than one delegated provider mutation in one steady-state iteration or omit mandatory post-transaction provider readback
silently recover an interrupted or ambiguous transaction without provider reconciliation
broaden reusable materialization, Writer Lease, autonomous merge/Issue-close, steady-state or durable-resume mutation authority
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime, ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: a machine-readable multi-session steady-state policy defines session-start, iteration, readback, checkpoint-refresh and interruption-reconciliation invariants
prior-session checkpoint and decision state is always historical hint-only data and cannot authorize a new session mutation
fresh canonical Work Unit/provider-state/branch/PR/CI truth is mandatory at every session start and after every delegated transaction
clean, interrupted and readback-pending handoff classes are deterministic, mutually exclusive and adversarially tested
multi-session evidence remains public-safe and contains no credentials, private runtime payload or secret-bearing transport data
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
